tos.title: ## AI Terms of Service
tos.description:
Welcome to {username} AI! Before you can start chatting and using AI features, you must agree to our Terms of Service.

By agreeing, you consent to:
• Having your messages processed by the AI.
• Allowing the AI to store memory facts you explicitly ask it to remember.

*If you disagree, you will be opted out and won't be able to use the AI.*
tos.agreed:
## Welcome to {username} AI!
Thank you for agreeing to the Terms of Service. You can now chat with the AI freely! Just mention me or reply to my messages.
tos.disagreed:
## Opted Out
You have chosen to disagree. You have been automatically opted out of all AI features, and any existing memories have been deleted.

If you change your mind, you can use the `/ai optout` command to opt back in.

ai.title: AI Help & Guide
ai.how_to_chat:
### How to Chat
Simply mention the bot or reply to its messages to start chatting! The AI understands natural language and can help you with various tasks.
ai.memory:
### Memory & Facts System

I can remember facts about you! Just say:
• **"Remember that I like pizza"**
• **"Ingat aku suka coding"**
• **"Catat bahwa saya dari Jakarta"**

Supported languages: English, Indonesian

I categorize facts into types like:
• Birthday, Name, Hobbies
• Location, Job, Education
• Preferences (food, music, games, etc.)

View your facts with `/ai facts` anytime!
ai.features:
### AI Features

**Multi-Media Support**
• Send images - I can describe and analyze them
• Share videos - I can understand video content
• Upload PDFs - I can read documents
• Share YouTube links - I can discuss videos

**Command Execution**
• Ask me to roll dice, check ping, play music
• I can execute bot commands for you!

**Web Search**
• Ask me current questions
• I can search the web for answers
ai.tips:
### Tips & Tricks

**Be conversational** - Talk to me naturally!
**Use context** - I remember our previous messages
**Ask follow-ups** - Continue the conversation
**Share media** - I can see images and videos
**Save facts** - Tell me things to remember

**Privacy Notes:**
• Conversation history is cached for 30 minutes
• Facts are stored until you delete them
• Use `/ai forget` to clear history
• Use `/ai facts` to manage your data
